The company positions it against this problem: Combine long-endurance vessel autonomy, stable hull design and modular payload integration for distributed maritime operations. Verified current scope: robot body/device. Stated ambition: unresolved beyond current company positioning. Public evidence does not establish responsibility for hardware, robot body, end effectors/tooling, models/policies, simulation/training, integration, commissioning/qualification, remote operations, ongoing support/maintenance and hardware financing/RaaS. Overall integration responsibility is classified as unclear. Commercial evidence: 0_no_verified_deployment; technical evidence: 2_marketing_specific. These are public-evidence classifications, not proof of contract scope, uptime, economics or performance.
